label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User input from Referer header flows through URL decode to doSomething() where bar=param initially, then if param.length()>1 the last character is replaced with 'Z'. However, this sanitization only affects the FINAL character - XSS payloads injected mid-string or early in the payload remain unmitigated. The guard allows user input through when length>1, making this a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows to bar; sanitizer only replaces last character leaving most of payload vulnerable
